title: Stock
subtitle: Stock and reservations, supplier orders, receiving and shipments by project

loadError.title: Could not load
loadError.text: Refresh the page or try again later.

unavailable.title: ERP is not responding
unavailable.text: Stock data is unavailable right now. Try again in a minute.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.text: Stock is available to roles with the Stock section. Ask the administrator if you need it.

errors.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this.
errors.unavailable: ERP is not responding. Try again later.
errors.below_reserved: Stock cannot drop below project reservations.
errors.below_shipped: A reservation cannot be less than what is already shipped.
errors.transition_not_allowed: The order is already in another status: refresh the screen.
errors.order_not_draft: Lines and supplier can only be changed in a draft.
errors.order_closed: The order is closed: it cannot be changed.
errors.order_not_confirmed: Goods can be received on a confirmed order.
errors.order_has_receipts: The order already has receipts: it cannot be cancelled.
errors.supplier_email_required: The supplier has no email: enter an address for the letter.
errors.email_failed: The letter to the supplier was not sent, the order status is unchanged. Try again later.
errors.fulfillment_not_ready: The project is not signed yet: shipping is possible after the contract is signed.
errors.product_required: Match the line to a catalog item first.
errors.no_shortage: No shortage: everything is reserved or already ordered.
errors.deal_closed: The request is closed: reservations are not taken.
errors.line_not_actual: The line belongs to an earlier quote version.
errors.line_not_goods: Services are not requested from goods suppliers.
errors.reservation_not_active: The reservation is already released or shipped.
errors.already_answered: The supplier reply is already marked.
errors.request_not_sent: The letter was not sent: nothing to mark.
errors.calc_not_started: The costing has not started yet.
errors.quantity_out_of_range: Quantity out of range: at most {{max}}.
errors.prices_forbidden: Supplier prices are entered by an employee with access to them.
errors.calc_task_not_found: No request with this number among requests with a costing task.
errors.request_and_line_together: Request and costing line are given together.
errors.role_not_permitted: Your role is not allowed to do this.

balances.search: Find an item by name or article
balances.caption: Stock and reservations by item

empty.title: The warehouse is empty for now
empty.text: Stock appears after receiving from a supplier or manual entry: find an item by search and open it to add stock.

emptySearch.title: Nothing found
emptySearch.text: Try another word from the name or article.

product.noCells: The item is not in stock.
product.releaseConfirm: Release the reservation for {{number}}? The goods return to free stock.

adjust.title: Add or write off · {{name}}
adjust.quantityHint: Plus adds, minus writes off. Stock cannot go below zero or below reservations.
consequence: The cell stock changes immediately.
The item movement log gets an entry with author and time.
Project reservations are untouched: stock will not drop below their total.

orders.search: Find an order: number, supplier, item
orders.caption: Supplier orders

empty.title: No supplier orders
empty.text: An order is created for a request shortage or by hand: a draft, then sent to the supplier by email.

create.title: New supplier order
create.requestHint: The order gets what is missing in the quote goods lines: quantity minus reservation minus already ordered.
consequence: A draft order with number PO-YYYY-NNN is created.
Nothing is sent to the supplier until you press “Send to supplier”.
Lines and prices can be edited while the order is a draft.
create.productHint: Type at least two letters of the name or article

order.title: Supplier order {{number}}
order.overdueBanner: Expected by {{date}}, goods not received — {{count}} d. overdue. Contact the supplier and update the expected date.

notFound.title: No such order
notFound.text: There is no order with this number, or it is not available to your role.

send.title: Send order {{number}} to the supplier
send.emailKnown: Address from the supplier card; you can enter another.
send.emailMissing: The supplier has no email: enter an address for the letter.
consequence: The supplier gets a letter with the order lines; they can reply to your mailbox.
The status becomes “Sent” and the order log gets an entry.
If the letter is not sent, the status does not change.

confirm.title: Supplier confirmed order {{number}}
confirm.dateHint: The expected date is needed to track delays.
consequence: The status becomes “Confirmed”, the delivery date is remembered.
If goods do not arrive by this date, the order appears in My tasks as overdue.
You can then receive goods by line.

cancel.title: Cancel order {{number}}
consequence: The order is closed, no letter goes to the supplier.
You can cancel while nothing has been received.
The reason is saved in the order log.

receive.title: Receive goods on order {{number}}
receive.hint: Enter how much arrived on each line: you can receive a part and the rest later.
consequence: Warehouse stock grows by the received quantity.
A line ordered for a project is reserved for it.
When everything is received the order becomes “Received”.

receipts.pendingCaption: Confirmed order lines waiting for goods
receipts.pendingScroll: Table of lines waiting for receiving

empty.title: Nothing expected
empty.text: Lines of confirmed orders whose goods are not fully received appear here.

shipments.hint: Enter a project number: we will show reservations that can be shipped.

noReservations.title: No reservations
noReservations.text: Nothing to ship from stock for {{request}}: no reservations or all already shipped.

shipments.readOnly: Shipping is done by an employee with stock rights.
consequence: Stock and the project reservation decrease by the shipped amount.
An internal waybill SHP-YYYY-NNN with tracking is issued.
When all quote goods are shipped, project fulfilment becomes “Shipped”.
shipments.caption: Shipments by project

empty.title: No shipments yet
empty.text: A shipment is made from project reservations after the contract is signed.

priceRequest.title: Request a supplier price · {{number}}
priceRequest.emailHint: The supplier has no email: enter an address to send the letter to.
priceRequest.noGoods: The costing has no goods to request a price for.
priceRequest.failed: The letter to “{{name}}” was not sent: the request stays in the log as “not sent”.
consequence: The supplier gets a letter with the request lines; they can reply to your mailbox.
The costing log gets an entry: who, when, to whom and which lines.
Enter the price from the reply into the costing line, then press “Reply received”.
